subject: Manipuri (Dance)
notes: Schools offer one style. Theory (30 marks, 2 hours) has no unit-wise split; practical is 70 marks.
Students are presumed to have preliminary training in the style.

chapters.name: History of Indian and Traditional Dance
topics: Brief history of Indian dance and traditional dance-drama

chapters.name: Themes in Manipuri
topics: Ramayana, Bhagavata, Gita Govinda; Nongpok Ningthou and Panthoibi

chapters.name: History of Manipuri Dance
topics: Lai Haraoba; Vaishnavite compositions from the 15th century; Ras Leela and Sankirtana under Maharaja Bhagyachandra; Goshtha Leela under Maharaja Chandrakirti

chapters.name: Manipuri Repertoire
topics: Rasleelas, Krishna and Radha Abhisar and Nartan, Punglon Jagoi, Dashavatar, Gita Govinda songs, Pung Cholom, Kartal Cholom

chapters.name: Distinctive Aspects of Manipuri
topics: Lasya and tandava; footwork; sarvanga abhinaya

chapters.name: Postures and Footwork
topics: Basic postures, movements and footwork in tanchap tala

chapters.name: Hand Movements and Chali
topics: Wrist flexibility, chali, champra okpi, khujeng leibi; chali for feminine and masculine, chali areibi

chapters.name: Lai Haraoba and Folk Dances
topics: Lasya and tandava; Thougal Jagoi, Maibi Jagoi; Thabal Chongbi, Keetlam, Chaplam
